description: Cited-answer web search: ask a question, get a short synthesized answer with citations to live web sources. Paid: $0.05 flat per call via x402. Limits: query 3..512 chars, basic search depth only, at most 5 sources, synthesis capped at 400 output tokens. Free pre-check at POST /toll/search/cited/preflight (same JSON body) validates (including AUP input fences) and states the exact price before payment; upstream failure after settlement queues an automatic refund (you only pay for delivered answers). — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/search/cited.
name: cited_answer_search
